_note: Glass panes (ADR 0007, docs/glass.md). building_pane_hp: a window of the base map (windows.json). vehicle_pane_hp: a pane of vehicles.json "glass" without its own hp. crack_stages: HP fractions, highest first, at which the crack grows (a damaged pane starts at stage 1). blast_damage: at a blast's centre, falling to nothing at its radius. building_reach / vehicle_reach: metres past where the bullet stopped that a pane may lie. shattered_exposes_riders: a shot through a shattered vehicle pane can hit the riders. The rest is the client's shatter animation.
